name: Tachibana Natsume
source:
Natsume is a girl with long blue hair. She is very aggressive and kicks the player and other characters during the storyline. She is Kazuki's senpai. She often does things her own way even though it defies common sense. She doesn't like to lose, and often acts before thinking. She is shrouded in mystery.

[From [url=https://gamicus.fandom.com/wiki/SchoolMate]Codex Gamicus[/url]]
